steps.title: Gothic Definition
steps.body: A genre that combines horror, death, romance and the supernatural. It explores what lies beneath the surface of civilization - our fears, desires and secrets.

steps.title: Scientific Supernatural
steps.body: Victorian Gothic often uses science to explain supernatural events. This reflects Victorian anxiety about science going too far - creating horrors through knowledge.

steps.title: The Secret as Society
steps.body: Gothic secrets reflect Victorian society's secrets - what respectable families hid behind closed doors. The secret reveals the hypocrisy beneath the surface.

steps.title: Gothic Analysis Strategy
steps.body: When writing about Gothic elements, the highest marks come from treating Gothic conventions as meaningful choices, not decorative features. Every Gothic element has an intellectual purpose: to explore anxiety, reveal repression, or challenge rationalism. Examiners reward responses that explain what Gothic conventions allow writers to say that realism alone cannot. For Grade 9, show how Gothic conventions function as a language of the unconscious — expressing fears and desires that Victorian society refused to acknowledge openly.
